# Statistics assets

- MapLibre GL JS 5.6.0: https://github.com/maplibre/maplibre-gl-js; see `maplibre/LICENSE.txt`. Bundled from the published npm distribution via unpkg. CSP JavaScript SHA-256: `e9038be2353aa748b56271bf15cf81a8240c5b9c46dabcc5f150499c1b97824a`; CSP worker: `127ae116b0d4c0e4a2d215d68b10300fa7c2365d0d234831ff037af5cff58524`; CSS: `792ac997dcf6ae6f643eb4e2dee4630c85e7056526bd8fb85ffe83c67d6c41b4`.
- World boundaries: Natural Earth, public domain, 1:110m admin-0 countries, from https://github.com/nvkelso/natural-earth-vector/blob/master/geojson/ne_110m_admin_0_countries.geojson (downloaded 2026-09-17). Properties reduced to country name and ISO code; coordinates preserved.
- Geographic lookup database (installed separately): DB-IP City Lite, CC BY 4.0, https://db-ip.com/db/lite.php. The map includes the required attribution link. Addresses are resolved locally, never sent to a third-party geolocation API.
